31420131.desc_art: 世界是一座喧嚷的大鬼宅，而她只想一个人清静会儿。

desc: 她曾经有过把汁拉贵司当作生日蛋糕的日子——手和脚在拥挤的空间中互相打架，朴实的祝愿和热闹的嬉戏萦绕耳畔。她本以为早就将此忘却，直到意识到自己正是依靠这份记忆，才得以疗愈双手和心中的伤口，这才恍然发现它一直藏在脑海深处。|从虚构集那里，拉莫纳知道了更多关于生命的隐喻。生命以哭声开始，以叹息结束，夹在中间的时日则如街头跑开的孩童，一晃而过。所以，她开始在生日这天戴上几朵具有纪念意义的花，装点自身、时日与生命。|一封信经由夜巡特遣管理局转递到了她手上，只需瞧上邮戳和字迹一眼，她就知道是由谁寄来的。还没来得及拆开，箱中的伙伴们便从信封背面的祝福语中得知了今天是她的生日，随即为她庆祝起来。正如信中所写，这封信本身便是一件礼物。不过，最终她究竟有没有看信，尚且是个谜团。
useDesc: 承载了珍贵记忆的彩色相片，可用于邀请此神秘学家。
desc2: 远离人群，走入夜色并与鬼同行的除灵师，你最擅长告别的朋友之一。

character_data.text:
神秘学家艺术品，展出于20世纪初，参展时长17年，诞生自4月13日春。参展于墨西哥的首都墨西哥城，曾计划巡展于世界各地，计划中断后暂藏于夜巡特遣管理局。

尺寸：66 1/8×33 1/16×31 1/8in.
介质：烟雾与火星
香调：木质馥奇调 快乐鼠尾草 薰衣草 蜡菊 兰花 雪松
灵感：引归的药草[木] 除灵师

character_data.title: 龙舌兰熏香棒
character_data.text:
龙舌兰叶、鼠尾草与艾蒿等植物编织而成的熏香棒，由受访者自制而成。
它的存在违背了两种传统：对于要和鬼魂打交道的人来说，龙舌兰叶并不具备驱魔的效用；对于普通人而言，龙舌兰的价值又在于其果实。
叶子就这样被丢在道路旁，路过的除灵师捡起它，让它远离了灰尘。

character_data.title: 调幅收音机
character_data.text:
一份来自异国的礼物，源于家长自以为的关心。
为了敲开她紧闭的房门，家长送上了一份属于世界的热闹。无师自通，她发现了太阳会影响电波的稳定。为了接收到信号，她常常在夜晚出门，寻找开阔的高处，收听固定的音乐频道。
在电离层干扰音频信号时，乐声偶尔扭曲变形如鬼魂啸叫，而她感受到了宁静，真实的宁静。

character_data.title: 彩蜡烛
character_data.text:
镌刻了古老术式的蜡烛，凝结着那些背身向内的时光。
受访者并未对除灵展露过多的热情，对她而言，这仅是一份普通的工作。当被问及是否在除灵工具上投入许多心血时，她同样给出了否定的答案。但是，当她不把辛劳视作苦闷的时候，是否已经可以称作热爱？

character_data.title: 旧童年
character_data.text:
他们——妈妈、爸爸和女儿——挤在二十平米的狭窄房子里。
命运赐予他们的物质太少，于是用乐观的性格弥补。他们的日子尚能过得去，而且充满欢声笑语。
在空闲的时候——他们最不缺的就是时间——窄窗里流动着下午五六点才会出现的阳光，尘埃浮动，他们看着女儿从屋内的一角跑向另一角。他们不理解女儿的异常行为，把这当作孩童的游戏。
房屋之外，世界也快速跑动着。新制度、新学校、新早餐，以及驶向异国的列车逐渐出现，一切都崭新如梦。他们不甘心成为旁观者，不甘心继续过这种担忧利息的日子。
推开门，他们那过分沉默的女儿缩在墙角，告诉他们家里有鬼，他们瞬间明白了女儿异常的缘由。
伟大的发现！
就像航海家发现了新大陆那样，他们撬开了平凡生活的壳，抬头看见了新的天空。口才有了用武之地，本被遗忘的血脉重新具有说服力。在祭司退居幕后，圣歌仅存辑录的时代，新的“通灵世家”就该应运而生。
廉洁的新闻报刊登载了他们的谎言，记者妙笔生花，女儿摇身一变成为小有名气的“除灵师”。他们搬进了新家，光线充足，时间变得紧张起来。
可为什么女儿变得越来越孤僻？越来越喜欢藏在墙角或柜子里？
没关系，惊悚电影里的怪角色，往往才是真大师！

character_data.title: 白日絮语
character_data.text:
……
1915年5月31日。
她有三个小时的时间来完成安德鲁先生的委托，地点位于十五公里外的村镇玉米地。他们乘坐的车在沙漠边缘一路颠簸，最终抵达了目的地。
安德鲁先生说，恶灵盘踞在玉米地，影响了眼前这条公路的修建进度，希望她能在两小时内完成除灵。
“效率！效率才是最重要的！”
在一堆建材后面，她看见了一个躲藏的村民。她很聪明，知道那才是鬼魂的真身。

1915年6月4日。
一个紧急委托——米格尔上尉家中出现了恶灵，上尉的家人怀疑是他死去的同僚作祟。她的父母声称这次委托是加塞儿的，因此收了两倍酬劳。
她已经能借助除灵药草和神秘术感知鬼魂的状态，那个躲在衣柜里的鬼魂其实并没有伤害上尉——它只是终日哭泣。
她照常进行了除灵，上尉并未对她进行感谢。

1916年2月3日。
城里新出现一些杂志和报纸，名为《肖像》的人物专访刊物向她递来了邀请。在她的父母的游说下，这篇访谈计划刊登于封面。
她跑了出去，躲在无人在意的阴影里，对世界说：“安静，请保持安静。”
那之后，她才决定告诉其他人，她并不能听见鬼魂讲话。
……

character_data.title: 红嘴巴，请闭上
character_data.text:
白雪松：嗯？拉莫纳小姐，你是在摆弄法阵吗？
白雪松：夜巡特遣管理局难道没有提前告知你，这张嘴是我的神秘术表现，而不是一只鬼？
拉莫纳：我知道，因为我能看见您，也能听见您在讲话。
拉莫纳：看来夜巡特遣也没有提前告知您，我其实是个喜欢开玩笑的人。
白雪松：这一点我提前了解过，但现在才算真正领教。你的幽默重点在于形式和切入时机，而非内容本身的滑稽性。
白雪松：就像刚刚那样，在一次访谈的开始插入笑话，的确让人猝不及防。
拉莫纳：我从没想到连“幽默”也能被分析。
白雪松：当然，它只是一种社交技巧。在社交场合，它通常用于缓解内心的焦虑与氛围的焦灼。看来，你并不喜欢被采访。
拉莫纳：好吧，我不否认。
白雪松：那我是不是也可以说，现在的你是一个很自洽的人，并没有把焦虑视作需掩藏的脆弱。
拉莫纳：嗯……您是我见过最会做分析的人了。但这样直白地说出来，多少有点……
白雪松：令人害羞？
拉莫纳：不够幽默。

character_voice.content: 我从来没有想过我会被人从纺车里头转出来。#0|相比之下，这片空间里拥挤而热闹的“灵”，都不算什么奇事了。#3.17
character_voice.encontent: Never figured that I'd be summoned by a spinning wheel one day. #0|That's a whole new kind of bizarre. Compared to that, this Suitcase of yours is almost normal ...#3.9

character_voice.name: 箱中气候
character_voice.content: 地面湿漉漉的，身上的衣服潮得能挤出水了，连薰香棒里的火星都昏昏欲睡……#0|在应对外部环境变化这件事上，#7.03|比起鬼魂，我们这些活着的人更容易受到影响。#9.79
character_voice.encontent: The world of the living is very sensitive to change; #0|a short rain wets the ground, soaks your shirt, and snuffs out the light of my smudge stick. #3.4|Things in the land of the dead don't change much.#10.11

character_voice.name: 致未来
character_voice.content: 在我七岁时，城里在修建一座有着穹窿屋顶的宏伟建筑。#0|等我到了十七岁，它已荒废多时，粗糙的墙面被日头晒出了暖意。#5.14|我总是喜欢在那未完工的屋顶下闲坐，想象它未来的样子。#11.66
character_voice.encontent: When I was seven, the city started building this palace of sorts. It was a massive thing topped with a dome. #0|But by the time I turned 17, they had forgotten all about it. Now it just stands there uncompleted, baking in the sun.#7.86|Sometimes I like to go and stand beneath its half-finished dome, just to sit in its shade.#19.22

character_voice.encontent: You've got a habit of sneaking up on people, don't you? #0|I've known spirits that were noisier than you.#3.53

character_voice.encontent: Want some? It's chilaquiles—tortilla and chiles—it's a good breakfast; #0|the tortilla gives you endurance, and there's nothing like hot chiles to wake you up. #7.1|That's what they'll tell you anyways.#12.42|I think people just eat what they've got and make the rest up later.#15.03

character_voice.encontent: Passion fruit juice, Miguel candle ... #0|Hey, Timekeeper. Just headed out on a job. Apparently, my latest client thinks exorcisms work better at night. #3.66|Classic, probably thinks ghosts wear bedsheets and say "boo"—#12.62|Huh, I look tired? Nah, I actually don't mind working late.#18.61

character_voice.content: 白鼠尾草的烟雾具备安神的功效，#0|只要闻上一会儿，纷乱的思维便会归于静谧，仿若回到了生命最洁净的状态。#2.98|司辰，等我们平静下来后，再互道晚安吧。#11.48
character_voice.encontent: Burning white sage has a calming effect. #0|Give it a moment, breathe it in deep, soon enough you'll feel like you've been stripped of all your burdens. #3.4|Let the sage do its work and you'll sleep as easy as a corpse.#13.87

character_voice.encontent: Huh? So, you can see that guy on my head too? #0|Careful. I've got the feeling there are more of them nearby.#5.76

character_voice.name: 袖与手
character_voice.content: 能量场被扰乱了，快，拿上龙舌兰熏香棒，观察烟雾变化的形态，追寻它的轨迹。#0|等等，扰乱者的身份是——维尔汀！#7.26|……好吧，你从来不懂我的幽默。#14.11
character_voice.encontent: I feel a disturbance in the pneuma! Quick, grab that agave incense and follow the smoke! #0|I see, I see; it's all very clear! The spirits are calling to you—Ahah, did I have you going there?#6.7|... Well, I thought it was funny.#20.39

character_voice.name: 衣着与身形
character_voice.content: 曾经我以为，#0|生命的本质正是其存在的形式。#1.48|但后来，我发现我们与鬼魂别无二致，#4.96|仅是因为人类无法理解鬼魂的表达，所以才妄下定论。#9.03
character_voice.encontent: For most of my life I didn't really believe in ghosts—ironic, I know. #0|To me, life was a thing you could touch; something to be seen, heard, and experienced. #6.24|But I've come to see things a different way. #13.63|Spirits experience things in a different way than you or I, but that doesn't mean they don't exist.#17.23

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 我喜欢和鬼魂们呆在一块儿，它们不吵不闹，也不撒谎。#0|是它们教会了我如何与世界共处，当然，以话语之外的形式。#4.91
character_voice.encontent: Ghosts are easy to get along with. They don't make much of a fuss or cause trouble. #0|Sometimes, though I didn't see it at the time, they've even helped me along my way.#6.5

character_voice.name: 嗜好
character_voice.content: 我喜欢和鬼魂们呆在一块儿，它们不吵不闹，也不撒谎。#0|是它们教会了我如何与世界共处，当然，以话语之外的形式。#4.91
character_voice.encontent: Ghosts are easy to get along with. They don't make much of a fuss or cause trouble. #0|Sometimes, though I didn't see it at the time, they've even helped me along my way.#6.5

character_voice.name: 赞赏
character_voice.content: 司辰，到现在为止你还从未对我说过“打起精神来”这句话。#0|众所周知，你不能强求一个必须工作的人保持振奋，#4.85|要是世界上所有老板都像你的话，需要我净化的地方肯定会少许多。#9.29
character_voice.encontent: You're a good leader, as far as I can tell. #0|You don't boss people around, and you don't expect perfection. Only effort. #2.74|Not many people are lucky enough to have that kind of leadership.#9.75

character_voice.name: 亲昵
character_voice.content: “噢！见鬼！”#0|这是我第一次在箱子里变成画时所说的话，本以为我永远不可能说出这句感慨呢。#2.37|司辰，能告诉我这其中的原理吗？#8.28|也许驱邪工具能探明缘由，但我不想破坏箱中的平静氛围。#11.53
character_voice.encontent: Working with spirits, I don't scare easy. #0|But damned if I didn't panic the first time I got pulled into that painting of yours. Bad memories, is all. #3.66|Part of me wants to whip out my gear and perform a purging on this cuadro maldito. #11.73|But I don't wanna mess up this nice lobby.#16.83

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 爸爸妈妈曾指望我变得声名赫赫，#0|但后来我定居在荒废的墓园中。#2.88|而在我以为我一辈子都不会离开墨西哥城的时候，我又来到了你的箱子里。#6.09|原来，奇遇并不总是伴随冲突和离别，也可能带来此刻的安逸……#12.17
character_voice.encontent: If my parents had their way, I would be living the high life and making big money; #0|instead, I wound up living in a cemetery on my own. #5.57|And if I had it my own way, I probably never would have left Mexico City. But here I am in your Suitcase. #10.32|Don't try to be what people expect of you, or even what you expected for yourself. You gotta let adventure take you where it will.#19.53

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 爸爸妈妈曾指望我变得声名赫赫，#0|但后来我定居在荒废的墓园中。#2.88|而在我以为我一辈子都不会离开墨西哥城的时候，我又来到了你的箱子里。#6.09|原来，奇遇并不总是伴随冲突和离别，也可能带来此刻的安逸……#12.17
character_voice.encontent: If my parents had their way, I would be living the high life and making big money; #0|instead, I wound up living in a cemetery on my own. #5.57|And if I had it my own way, I probably never would have left Mexico City. But here I am in your Suitcase. #10.32|Don't try to be what people expect of you, or even what you expected for yourself. You gotta let adventure take you where it will.#19.53

character_voice.name: 闲谈Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 虚构集小姐拉着我问了“除灵”相关的问题，还做了不少笔记。#0|她把我的蜡烛称作“火种”，#4.58|把熏香棒看成一张弓，#6.28|甚至连我听不见鬼魂说话这件事，都被她写作“双重的神性”……#8.26|很遗憾，这不是我，这简直是“翡翠裙”女神。#13.51
character_voice.encontent: Señorita Recoleta has taken an interest in my exorcism rituals. I think she wants to put them in her book.#0|Though, I don't think she's got the right idea about it. #8.08|She's been calling my candles "sparks of life" and the incense sticks "bows of abjuration," #12.5|and my relationship with the spirits is apparently some "sign of divinity." #19.63|I feel like she's got me confused with a goddess.#26.18

character_voice.name: 独白
character_voice.content: “勿忘你终有一死”，所以我们从不避讳死亡，相反，我们为它举办欢快热闹的节日，#0|死亡在侧，反而令生命如花与火光般明亮璀璨……#7.58|我们会悲伤，会沮丧，但从不绝望。#12.67
character_voice.encontent: Memento mori. If Mexicanos aren't the masters of it, then I don't know who is. #0|We don't fear talking about death; we celebrate it and keep our departed close to our minds and hearts. #7.56|Because it's only when you understand that death is always with you that you begin to see how precious life really is.#15.54

character_voice.name: 入队
character_voice.content: 可以当我不存在。#0
character_voice.encontent: Yeah, don't worry about me. I'll be right here.#0

character_voice.name: 战前
character_voice.content: 我只对付你们看不见的那些存在。#0
character_voice.encontent: I'd rather deal with the unseen world.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 准备净化。#0
character_voice.encontent: I'll handle the purification.#0

character_voice.name: 择选咒语Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 用点儿物理手段。#0
character_voice.encontent: Give me something heavy.#0

character_voice.name: 择选高阶咒语
character_voice.content: 别再迷失。#0
character_voice.encontent: Astray no more.#0

character_voice.name: 择选至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 该送它离开了。#0
character_voice.encontent: It's time to go.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 虚妄消却，不辩自明。#0
character_voice.encontent: Ilusiones, apartaos. La verdad se revela.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 此地，此刻，示我，现我。#0
character_voice.encontent: Este lugar, este instante. Revelado ante mí. Mostrado para mí.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 妄念止息，真容显露。#0
character_voice.encontent: Las mentiras se desvanecen; la verdad se desvela.#0

character_voice.name: 释放神秘术Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 真形，真名，勿隐，勿藏。#0
character_voice.encontent: Verdad revelada, disfraces disipados.#0

character_voice.name: 召唤至终的仪式
character_voice.content: 此处，彼处，往世，来世！#0
character_voice.encontent: ¡Abraza la luz... hacia las tierras más allá de la muerte!#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅰ
character_voice.content: 乱糟糟的……#0
character_voice.encontent: This is a mess ...#0

character_voice.name: 受敌Ⅱ
character_voice.content: 别缠着我。#0
character_voice.encontent: Leave me alone.#0

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 像花、像歌，#0|它们的灵魂会飞往光明之处。#2.82
character_voice.encontent: Their souls will reach the bright side,#0|flying over blooming fields of marigolds.#2.5

character_voice.name: 战斗胜利
character_voice.content: 像花、像歌，#0|它们的灵魂会飞往光明之处。#2.82
character_voice.encontent: Their souls will reach the bright side,#0|flying over blooming fields of marigolds.#2.5

character_voice.name: 洞悉
character_voice.content: 我不是那种擅长处理复杂问题的人，#0|这就是我无法满足父母的愿望，成为一个家喻户晓的除灵师的原因。#2.84|但过上简单的生活也有好处，#8.22|眼前的路只有一条，无论灵魂如何轮回，最终都会回到这里。#11.35
character_voice.encontent: I don't really much care for dealing with people. Living ones, anyway—they're too complicated. #0|Guess that's why I never got along well with my parents. #6.73|They wanted to make me famous. But I've always preferred the simple life; #9.9|I think that's what keeps me on the right path.#15.14

character_voice.name: 洞悉之底
character_voice.content: 精简法阵的结构，保持火星常燃，熟读咒语的念法……#0|在工作中保持好习惯，#5.07|就能够留出更多的休息时间。#6.9|加点儿智慧，偷懒就变成了捷径。#9.25
character_voice.encontent: If you do your work right the first time, you won't have to do it again. #0|Simplify your rituals when possible, always keep the incense burning,#4.26| and have the incantations memorized before you begin. #8.8|Put a little brains into your work, and it goes by much faster.#12.55

skin.skinDescription: 她懂得保持工作新鲜感的诀窍。

skin.name: 拉莫纳
skin.skinDescription: 不可听的，不可视的，都在走向她。

1352011.content: 司辰，你需要我为荒原进行一次除灵吗？
无论白天或夜晚，这里都十分热闹。
我并不是真的打算驱逐这些居住在箱中的好友。
原来他们还愿意跟我一起看恐怖片吗？
在昨夜的电影播放完之后，我告诉参加派对的大家，房间的角落里一直有一个陪同我们观看的家伙……
那时候他们的表情可都不太好看呢。

1352012.content: 你每次都步履匆匆，极少在此处停留。
看来“司辰”的工作，也并非想象中的轻松。
……维尔汀，你一定是在开玩笑，对吧？
照拂来箱中拜访的每位友人，布置箱中大厅，为大家筹备洞悉仪式……这都是只有你才能完成的事情。
那我们来一起采摘一些狐儿尾吧！
将草药处理过后，我可以把它的花朵缝进手套和鞋子里送给你。
这可以隐匿你的踪迹，就不会有人留意到你正在忙里偷闲了……

1352011.content: 他们并不是恶灵，而是我们的友人。
我只是受托来邀请你参加今夜的惊悚派对。
